title: eval-harness: add per-prompt regression CI hook for prompt-set changes
author: Aisha Raman
release_notes: Add per-prompt regression CI hook that runs lightweight evals on changed prompt-sets and blocks merges when quality thresholds are exceeded. Includes GitHub Action, runner helper, and threshold config.
description:
Motivation:
Small but important safety net: when engineers update prompt-sets (or add new ones) we should catch regressions at PR time. Large eval runs are expensive, so this PR adds a lightweight per-prompt CI hook that computes baseline metrics for changed prompt-sets and fails the PR if a regression threshold is exceeded.

What this PR does:
- Adds a GitHub Action workflow .github/workflows/eval-per-prompt.yml that triggers on pull_request and runs only when files under eval/prompt-sets/ are changed.
- Implements eval_harness/ci/runner.py: a small harness to run a sampled subset of prompt cases across the candidate model(s), compute metrics (accuracy, BLEU-like similarity, and a custom quality score), and compare against stored baselines.
- Introduces eval/prompt-sets/README.md with guidance and a baseline.json format for thresholds.
- Adds a lightweight docker image reference and caching logic to avoid re-downloading model artifacts in CI.

Commits (summary):
- 9f1c2a0: initial GH action + workflow scaffolding
- 2b3f4d8: add runner + metric computation and CLI
- 7a9e03f: baseline storage + upload/download helper for CI cache
- e12b7c3: docs and examples for adding new prompt-sets
- f0c4b91: tune thresholds after initial integration test failures

Files changed (high level):
- .github/workflows/eval-per-prompt.yml (+120 lines) - new GH Action to gate prompt changes
- eval_harness/ci/runner.py (+260) - CLI runner used by workflow; exposes --prompt-dir, --baseline, --thresholds
- eval/prompt-sets/sample-set/baseline.json (+1) - example baseline metrics for sample-set
- eval/prompt-sets/sample-set/prompts.yaml (+1) - example prompts added in this PR
- docker/ci/Dockerfile (+30) - small image for reproducible CI runs
- README and docs updates (+8)

Behavior and gating rules:
- The CI hook runs on PRs that modify files under eval/prompt-sets/. It detects which prompt-sets are touched and runs a sampled eval (configurable sample size, default 50 cases) against the candidate commit's evaluation binary.
- For each metric we compute delta = new - baseline. If any metric delta crosses a configurable threshold (declared in baseline.json, example: quality_drop > 0.05), the job fails and posts a short summary comment on the PR with top-k failing examples.
- We keep the job duration intentionally small (~3-6 minutes) by sampling and running on a small vetted model variant (fast open model). Full evals remain part of nightly jobs.

Review thread (highlights):
- Jordan Lee (reviewer): "Nice shape. Can we ensure the action only runs for prompt changes and not for unrelated docs updates?"
  - Aisha: "Yes — action uses a path filter. I also added an explicit changed-files detector in runner so the step is skipped early."
- Priya Patel: "What about flakiness in similarity metric? Might want to exclude a few prompts or add a stability smoothing window."
  - Aisha: "Added 3-run median smoothing option and updated baseline format to include "stability_score". Default smoothing is enabled in CI."
- Marco Alvarez: "Please ensure secrets/credentials limitations for private models — CI should not leak or attempt to pull gated model weights."
  - Aisha: "Runner uses a public fast model in CI by default. If teams opt into private-model checks they'll need to add runner config in their repo and supply credentials in repo secrets; documented in README."

CI run history for this PR:
- Initial run (first push): failed — 1 test in runner timed out due to a model download race; logs show transient network error.
- Second run (after caching fix + smaller image): passed. Full set of checks: unit-tests (pass), lint (pass), eval-per-prompt (pass).

Post-merge notes and follow-ups:
- Backfill: we triggered a one-off job to collect baselines for existing prompt-sets and wrote baseline.json into each set where missing (see follow-up task ENG-4590).
- Monitoring: created an alert in Ops dashboard that surfaces a spike in per-prompt CI failures across repos (suggests model regression or dataset drift).
- Docs: included contributor guidance for how to add new prompt-sets and tune thresholds.

Merge outcome:
- Merged via squash-and-merge on 2026-02-14 after approvals from Jordan and Priya.

Notes for reviewers in future PRs:
- If your change touches >3 prompt-sets consider marking PR as "eval:skip" only after discussion; otherwise the per-prompt check will run.
- Threshold tuning: if a PR is blocked by the hook but you believe the regression is acceptable, file ENG-4523 to request a baseline update with artifact evidence and a small canary run.

If anything needs follow-up or you'd prefer a smaller sample size for the CI job by default, I can open a follow-up PR to tweak the workflow sampling parameter.
